about: Threat-intel snapshots the estate can use with NO network. `./securax offline sync` refreshes them when you are online; everything that uses them keeps working (and says how old they are) when you are not.

kev.what: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities: CVEs attackers are using right now. Prioritise these first.

attack.what: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise: technique id → name and tactics (slim extract; the 55 MB bundle is streamed, never loaded whole).
attack.licence: © The MITRE Corporation. Approved for public release. Used under the ATT&CK Terms of Use: https://attack.mitre.org/resources/terms-of-use/

epss.what: FIRST EPSS: the chance each CVE is exploited in the next 30 days (CVEs at 10% or more are kept, about 0.4 MB). Ranks what to patch first.
epss.licence: Free to use; cite FIRST EPSS (first.org/epss)
